name: limit-alerts-status
description: Experimental: a /limits command that prints every usage window, its reset time and the data source instantly, with no model turn.

warn.title: Warning threshold
warn.description: Percent at which a window gets a warning mark in the report.

crit.title: Critical threshold
crit.description: Percent at which a window gets a critical mark in the report.

state_dir.title: State directory
state_dir.description: Where usage-monitor-cache.json lives. Empty: UM_STATE_DIR, then ~/.claude/scripts, then the limit-alerts plugin data directory.
